svg.title: Pixel reconstruction vs JEPA
svg.desc: Top: a reconstruction model encodes a masked image and a decoder must output all 3072 pixel values; the loss is computed in pixel space. Bottom: a JEPA encodes views and compares 16-number embeddings; the loss is computed in representation space and there is no decoder.
svg.text: (e.g. masked autoencoders (MAE); not part of this repo, shown for contrast)
3,072 = 32×32×3 values of one Shapes image; 16 = projector output size in runs/shapes-desktop
